presentation.description:
Alerts you before Gold Saucer GATE events with configurable per-GATE preferences, countdown overlay, DTR bar timer, and chat/toast notifications. Detects active GATEs via chat and GATE Keeper NPC dialogue for early reveals. Use /gate to toggle overlay, /gate config for settings.
